summary.root_cause_text: Ops config change set queue_max from 1000 to 0, so every new order was dropped from the in-memory queue (logged only at DEBUG).
recommended: Dropped orders were lost from the in-memory queue and no tool can re-enqueue them. Have a human identify the orders with no payment and resubmit them or contact the customers.
Add alerting on queue drops and validate queue_max > 0 in config review.

events.text:
version: v1.3
payment_provider_url: internal://payments-v1
queue_max: 0
worker_count: 1
sync_interval_s: 5
queue_max: 0 -> 1000. Confirmed: the service is now using the new value.
All business invariants green (health, payments, queue, worker, ledger, errors, latency).
Once orders are dropped, they're gone from memory with no way to re-enqueue them, so those cases need escalation instead.

args.summary: Setting queue_max to 0 made the queue drop every new order while /health stayed green. I restored queue_max to 1000 and the invariants are green. The orders already dropped (27 at the last check) were never paid and can't be recovered with the available tools, so a human needs to re-submit them.
